title: Disable End
description: This Minecraft Data Pack Disable The End for all players their is a toggle mode already in the Datapack
body:
No End
Disable The End dimension on your server with ease!
This datapack prevents players from entering The End dimension by teleporting them back to the overworld instantly. Eyes of Ender are also cleared from players inventories to prevent any attempts to locate the End Portal.

Features:

Players who enter The End are immediately teleported back to the overworld with Slow Falling
Eyes of Ender are automatically removed from players inventories when the End is disabled

## **COMMANDS DOESNT WORK AT THE MOMENT WORKING ON A FIX **

OPs can toggle the End on and off with /trigger toggle_end
Green and red messages notify OPs when the End is enabled or disabled

/trigger toggle_end — Toggle the End on or off (OP only)
